entries.0506d0f80e0ed3e5: Purchase and sale of used commercial vehicles
entries.39ce3b8c124f9e7d: A company that buys and sells commercial vehicles such as used trucks and also provides rental and maintenance, with subsidiaries engaged in freight transport and fuel transport.
entries.47dc222cb885f425: Businesses that purchase or use commercial vehicles
entries.53fa313d2c5023cc: Businesses and general customers requesting vehicle inspections or maintenance
entries.64c6812f38b677b1: The business consists of general cargo transportation undertaken by subsidiary Ｔ.Ｌ.Ｇ Co., Ltd. and fuel transportation undertaken by Marushin Unyu Co., Ltd. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥848 million.
entries.70dea9182e80cdc8: The company purchases trucks, dump trucks, and specialty vehicles such as concrete mixer trucks, refrigerated trucks and tank trucks, inspects and maintains them at its own factories, and sells them through 8 bases nationwide. Its subsidiary SUN AUTO Co., Ltd. carries out export sales, mainly overseas. The amount is not separately disclosed.
entries.8cea7fd29c2812e7: The business centers on the purchase and sale of used commercial vehicles, and also includes rental and leasing centered on refrigerated and freezer trucks and automobile maintenance at designated factories. Vehicles offered for sale are inspected and maintained at the company's own factories, and their specifications can be changed to suit customer requests. Its subsidiary SUN AUTO Co., Ltd. exports and sells used commercial vehicles, vehicle parts and other items, mainly to overseas markets. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥7,125 million.
entries.a35a224e84b6557d: Businesses that use vehicles through rental or leasing
entries.f435764c2eeffeb0: The company rents mainly refrigerated and freezer trucks, as well as wing trucks, vehicle-mounted vehicles, garbage trucks, arm roll trucks and others, and leases vehicles to customers who use them over the medium to long term. The amount is not separately disclosed.
entries.fa2fae9c005d7231: Leveraging the strength of its designated factories, the company provides after-sales support for the vehicles it sells and, for general customers, services such as vehicle inspections, maintenance, body repair and painting. The amount is not separately disclosed.
